A dynamic pedal with up to 35db of gain, full of complex harmonic character. Videos Meridian Simultaneously a harmonic-laden boost and low-gain overdrive, the Saturn VI eludes categorization. With it's finely tuned voicing, while adding sweet harmonic richness to your instrument, the Saturn VI is in it for the details. An update to the renowned Saturn V released in 2012, we’ve added new features, taking this unique circuit to the next level. BOOST WITH THE POWER OF 10 SUNS Within its intuitive control layout, the heart of the Saturn VI lies with the Boost and Drive controls. Using Boost alone gives you 18db of harmonic gain to push your tubes through the event horizon. Adjusting the Drive control brings more harmonic distortion, while also increasing the total output of the pedal. Cranking both controls to max will yield 35db of boost, full of complex harmonic character. DYNAMIC HARMONIC SPARKLE The Saturn VI brings a general openness to the top end of the frequency spectrum, while keeping bass frequencies fully present, tight and controlled. This makes the Saturn VI a great boost for electric bass as well. We’ve added a new Tone circuit to allow customization of the treble frequencies, so you can adjust for the perfect amount of sparkle. The harmonic distortion present is extremely dynamic. Play with a light touch and you’ll get a clean tone, but dig in and the Saturn VI will respond. The drive texture within the Saturn VI is comprised of both odd and even harmonics. The Boost side of the pedal is focused on subtle even-order harmonics, while the Drive side increases these and brings odd-order harmonics to the mix. While it excels as a harmonic booster, the Saturn VI crosses into the realm of overdrive when using the Drive control. It also works well with other pedals, opening new sonic dimensions with boost, fuzz, and overdrive effects. Saturn VI FEATURES Up to 18db clean boost; maximum 35db boost with Drive Adds lively harmonic sweetness to your existing tone without compromise A unique circuit with a finely tuned voicing True-Bypass relay switching via soft momentary footswitch A CADET SERIES PEDAL The Cadet Series brings Spaceman’s signature sonic character to a wider audience through repeatable, SMD-based designs. Classic Spaceman designs with the same attention to tone and detail, these pedals offer consistent availability, accessible pricing, and everyday reliability - without sacrificing the individuality that defines Spaceman. Screen printed faceplates and raw metal enclosures set this series apart. Ideal for working musicians and pedalboard-ready setups, the Cadet Series is where our craft meets practicality. SETTINGS from Command Central ★ SETTINGS from Command Central Chimey Overdrive Dynamic, amp-like overdrive with a clear chimey tone. Turn up the Fuzz control to boost your tubes Wall of Fuzz Huge blooming fuzz tone, that still retains clarity. Use your neck pickup for extra plumpness Clean Up Your Act Use your guitar volume knob to experience a range from chimey clean to fuzzy goodness Organic Overdrive A warmer, amp-like overdrive with a bit more grit. More mids, smoother highs Videos TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS Width: 2.6 inches / 66 mm Depth: 4.73 inches / 120 mm Height: 2.17 inches / 55 mm Weight: 10.3 ounces Input Resistance: 1Meg Ohm Bypass Current Draw: 9.5 mA Engaged Current Draw: 32 mA EXP
